selectionContract.rule: Selecting one style loads storyboard, persona, drywriter, voice/TTS, subtitle, music/SFX, camera, transition, prompt pack, Template1, Template2 and domain routes.
selectionContract.seedPromotion: CANDIDATE -> VERIFIED -> ACTIVE only after E2E render QA

styles.personaRule: Resolve PERSONA_ID for visible characters; treat hand/pen overlay separately.
styles.drywriterRule: Compress situation/conflict into visual metaphors and narration-relevant objects.
styles.cameraRule: Use subtle pan/zoom only after major draw steps.
styles.actionRule: Reveal only narration-relevant stroke paths; keep completed sketch fixed.
styles.audioRule: VO is master timeline; analyze reusable TTS style when voice exists.
styles.subtitleRule: Phrase-level sync; avoid the active drawing region; analyze font/box/emphasis/motion as SUBTITLE_STYLE_ID.

styles.personaRule: Keep cooking host PERSONA_ID consistent across all character shots.
styles.drywriterRule: Map recipe steps to short explanation, action and taste reaction beats.
styles.cameraRule: Alternate medium character, overhead ingredient, and macro food closeup shots.
styles.actionRule: Use realistic cooking hand actions for instructional steps.
styles.audioRule: Sync narration to RECIPE_STEP_ID and preserve reusable presenter TTS parameters.
styles.subtitleRule: Use short ingredient/action labels in safe margins.

styles.personaRule: Use 2-3 stable PERSONA_IDs with consistent relationship, speech style and reactions.
styles.drywriterRule: Use everyday problem, dialogue, misunderstanding, comic escalation, turn and one-line reflection.
styles.cameraRule: Use medium two-shot, reaction closeup, then a calm final hold.
styles.actionRule: Drive the message through dialogue and reaction rather than lecture.
styles.audioRule: Dialogue first; reflective narration only in final 10-20 percent; analyze dialogue TTS styles separately by persona.
styles.subtitleRule: Dialogue subtitles plus one concise final reflection line.

styles.personaRule: Attach lifestyle personas only when people appear.
styles.drywriterRule: Explain space function and user flow rather than generic beauty claims.
styles.actionRule: Reveal circulation and material details sequentially.
styles.audioRule: Calm spatial guide VO when present.

styles.personaRule: Staff/customer personas are secondary to brand and space identity.
styles.drywriterRule: Brand hook -> spatial feature -> user experience.
styles.audioRule: Short commercial VO plus ambient sound.

styles.personaRule: Use resident/customer persona only in lifestyle stage.
styles.drywriterRule: Problem/requirement -> design decision -> realized space -> user result.
styles.cameraRule: Plan/isometric view transitions into stable real-space camera.
styles.actionRule: Preserve geometry while moving from design representation to reality.
styles.audioRule: Design-explanation VO with clear pauses at transformation points.
styles.subtitleRule: Plan labels, room names and change-point captions.
